errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled with a numerical range. The values -1.3 and 4.5 are the minimum and maximum data values shown on the bars, not axis labels.
The vertical axis has no tick marks or scale labels, so stating that it has an interval of 1 is a hallucination.
